en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a metal arch bridge crossing a small river in a town. Behind the bridge stand ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with steep roofs and decorative façades, partly obscured by tall trees. In the far background a church or town‑hall tower rises above the rooftops. The caption in red Gothic-style print at the top left reads "Döbeln i. Sa. Königstraße.", indicating the street and town depicted.
